valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E: FY2027 non-GAAP diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027), using only information public by the 2026-11-13 close. FY2026 non-GAAP EPS is estimated at $4.37 (nine-month actual $3.09 plus Q4 guidance midpoint $1.28). Calendar 2026 revenue guidance is $13.3B (raised with Q3 results). Initial FY2027 guidance is 38-40% revenue growth (UBS summary of the Nov 3 call; guidance midpoint about $18.5B). Base EPS scales FY2026 EPS by the revenue ratio at a flat non-GAAP operating margin of about 49%. US listing, USD, no ADR conversion. The Q3 release of 2026-11-03 is before the reference close and is used.

bear.driver: Hyperscaler AI build timing slips and component supply constrains shipments; FY2027 revenue growth about 30% and non-GAAP operating margin eases to 47%

base.driver: Management's initial FY2027 guide (38-40% growth, about $18.5B revenue) delivered at a steady 49% non-GAAP operating margin

bull.driver: Revenue growth of about 50% (UBS view of 2027), AI networking share gains and operating leverage hold margin at 49%

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS $6.08 the close of $197.29 implies 32.4x. The Street-level target of about $250 (mean of the published consensus) implies 41x base EPS, or about $7.14 EPS at 35x, 17% above the base case.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $6.08 (about 3.1 pp of the close). A 10% change in FY2027 EPS moves the base target by about $21 (about 11 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: FY2027 revenue growth against the 38-40% guide and non-GAAP operating margin against about 49% (gross margin guided at 62-64%)
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 and full-year 2026 results, expected February 2027, which should include the FY2027 guidance update

analyst_notes: Named broker calls cluster after the Nov 3 Q3 release: UBS (259 to 291), Truist (234 to 240), Morgan Stanley (220 to 230), Piper Sandler (240 to 261) and Needham (260) raised or held Buy, while Wells Fargo cut to 245 from 255. Targets of $230-$291 sit 17-48% above the close against a 7.9% base case, a gap of about 3 P/E turns on the $6.08 base EPS, or roughly 17% more 2027 EPS at 35x. No call carries a verified 12-month horizon, so all rows stay in the timeline and none enter a weighted target. The Rosenblatt, TD Cowen and Needham July-August rows were taken from search summaries because the MarketBeat pages returned HTTP 403 when fetched; the Melius $305 target and published consensus (about $250, 28-30 analysts) are undated aggregates and are not in the events.
